tooltip.tfcagricultureplus.adult_silkwor: An adult silkworm lives for about seven in-game days.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.cooking_pan: Place the pan above a lit TFC heat source, add plant oil, then up to eight ingredients. Stir with a metal spatula; take the dish with a plate.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.nursery_tray: Put an A/B seed in the tray, wait for a seedling, then transplant the seedling onto suitable farmland.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.mushroom_bag: Eleven mushroom species can be cultivated. Growth needs the species' temperature range; the bag has a limited number of uses.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.silkworm_rac: A temperature-controlled silkworm rack: feed leaves, collect eggs, and process cocoons into silk.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.drying_rack: Holds one item. Supported drying recipes use weather and time; take the result when finished.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.cutting_boar: Used for cutting-board recipes. Place dough or ingredients on the board and follow the press/knead/confirm controls.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.log_cutting_: An early cutting board made from a log; usable before a saw is available.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.knife_block: Stores up to nine knives/tools. Right-click with a tool to insert; empty-hand right-click takes one out.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.mortar: Put food in the mortar and grind it with a pestle. Grinding consumes pestle durability.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.kitchen_stor: Kitchen furniture has different storage rules: counters hold anything, spice racks hold spices, food displays hold food, sinks hold fluid containers.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.metal_can: A 500 mB metal can made by anvil from a wrought iron sheet. It holds the fluids in its fluid tag and shows the contained fluid on its icon.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.serving_plat: Clay plates are knapped, fired and optionally dyed before firing. Place a plate to serve pan dishes; it stores the dish data.
jei.tfcagricultureplus.info.propagation_: Vegetative planting stock: use on farmland or shallow water to plant the species at age 0. One crop product crafts into two stock.
